name: @mieweb/deploy-contract
description: The @mieweb deploy-provider contract: a minimal, provider-agnostic TypeScript interface (`DeployProvider`) that @mieweb/cli consumes and deploy backends implement. Cloudflare/wrangler is the reference provider (@mieweb/deploy-wrangler); opensource-server (os.mieweb.org) is another. Zero dependencies — types plus a small conformance test-kit. No wrangler.jsonc field names, no backend API shapes, and no `mieweb+<driver>:` ID grammar leak into the contract; those are provider implementation details.
author: MIEWEB
